trigger.description: The workspace search index is healthy (IndexHealth::Ready), but the active embedder reports semantic=false — the deterministic-hash fallback — or a semantic embedder is active over a non-empty corpus with zero embedded vectors. Either way every retrieval is served by the lexical arm alone, which under-recalls paraphrases and synonyms of indexed content. Before this code existed, `ee status` reported `search: ok` in exactly this state.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Cargo workspace uses Rust nightly.' --workspace . --level semantic --kind fact --json
